name: System Securities Account Type 1 Code
definition: Lists the type of the securities account specific for a system.

CSDP.name: CSD Participant Account
CSDP.definition: Account owned by a CSD Participant|.

CSDM.name: CSD Mirror Account
CSDM.definition: Account operated by CSD for mirroring positions|.

ICSA.name: Inter CSD Account
ICSA.definition: Account operated by CSD for settlement of securities legs for instructions involving internal CSD s.

TOFF.name: Technical Offset Account
TOFF.definition: Account operated by CSDs in a direct holding market context.

CSDO.name: CSD Omnibus Account
CSDO.definition: Account operated by CSD in cross-CSD settlement context.

ISSA.name: Issuance Account
ISSA.definition: Account reflecting the holdings of the participants of the issuer CSD for a given financial instrument.
